notes.title: 🎉 Out Now: Sugardew Island Kickstarter
notes.content:
The wait is over! ❣️
Sugardew Island has officially launched on Kickstarter. Don't miss your chance to be part of this heartwarming adventure from the very start. Join us now on Kickstarter and dive into the unique world of Sugardew Island.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44843737/f5a13c2f131174a0fb6bbe8bacc3a524d4ac30b7.png

[previewyoutube=bkn-mfopmXM;full]TRAILER[/previewyoutube]

Your cozy farm shop
Step into a charming world where your shop is the heart of the community. In this cozy game, you'll manage your own farm shop, meticulously selecting goods to sell to the adorable Forest Folk. While caring for your animals and overseeing your farm play a role, your main focus is on enhancing your shop, fulfilling orders from the Harmony Tree, and revitalizing the island. Ready to become the cornerstone of Sugardew Island's revival? Launch your farm shop adventure now and make a lasting impact!

Early Bird special
Early Bird specials are available, but they won't last forever. Secure your exclusive rewards and help bring the enchanting world of Sugardew Island to life. Join our Kickstarter for all the latest updates and insider info.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44843737/a463110f2c0e8f33efc7f650fcf0205f97b38503.png

Are you interested? Then visit our Kickstarter Campaign and take a look at unreleased material. We look forward to your support.

Thank you for your support 💓
Team rokaplay

notes.title: Discover the secrets of The Forgotten Land on June 25!
notes.content:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33025590/42a0ba8a82054f3837e35051e45974efb474c331.png

A clue leads you on a journey to a mysterious place..

The Forgotten Land will be released on June 20! 

The Forgotten Land is an exciting turn-based "Combat & Puzzle Match 3" with streamlined RPG and Management elements in a dark fantasy setting. Set up a sheltering camp, improve your heroes' abilities and unlock tactical bonuses.

Show your combat skills! 
In turn-based battles you have to outwit your opponents' tactics, thwart their chances for counterattacks and cleverly use the special powers of your team
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33025590/9c9fcab605dd4803b5c7628b048389e951a4b460.png


Level up to new strenghts! 
Grow along your journey. 
Develop your team and improve your heroes' individual abilities!
